title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
In this position... The Senior AI Engineer at Ford Credit is a hands-on individual contributor on the AI Hub, Ford Credit''s enterprise platform for building, deploying, and governing AI agents and applications. Built on Google Cloud and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AI Hub enables engineers across the organization to develop AI solutions using a secure, scalable, and governed framework. You will help build and operate key platform capabilities, including agent services, developer tooling, deployment pipelines, retrieval and knowledge systems, shared context services, and governance controls. Working closely with product management, architecture, security, reliability engineering, and business teams, you will deliver platform features that enable engineers to develop AI solutions confidently and responsibly. This role requires strong software engineering expertise, experience with cloud-native and AI technologies, excellent communication skills, and a passion for building scalable platforms that balance innovation with governance and operational excellence. What you''ll do... Design, build, and maintain key components of Ford Credit''s AI platform, including agent frameworks, platform services, developer tools, and deployment pipelines. Build and enhance enterprise knowledge and context capabilities such as retrieval services, knowledge systems, shared memory, and agent integration services. Partner with internal customers to deliver and support AI-powered solutions from concept through production. Embed governance, security, observability, and compliance controls into the platform to support responsible AI development. Create reusable templates, tools, documentation, and best practices that enable engineers to build and deploy AI solutions efficiently. Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards to promote high-quality software development. Collaborate with vendor and partner teams to ensure solutions align with Ford Credit standards and can be effectively operated and extended internally. Work closely with product management, architecture, security, site reliability engineering (SRE), and developer enablement teams to deliver platform capabilities. Build solutions that meet the requirements of a regulated financial services environment, including security, privacy, auditability, and data governance. Help establish best practices for combining deterministic business processes with AI-driven capabilities in a transparent and auditable manner. 

 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor''s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications and services. Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java. Experience developing cloud-native applications on Google Cloud Platform or comparable cloud environments. Hands-on experience building applications using large language models (LLMs), agent frameworks, retrieval systems, and tool integration. Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, APIs, internal tooling, or CI/CD automation. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing, code quality, observability, and maintainability. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Master''s degree in a related technical field. Experience designing and operating AI agents in production environments. Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, semantic search, or enterprise knowledge systems. Experience in financial services or other regulated industries. Experience with AI governance, model risk management, or responsible AI practices. Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or command-line tools. Google Cloud certifications. #LI-MF2

title: ML Operation Engineer
description:
Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced MLOps Engineer with a strong background in building and deploying machine learning (ML) and large language models (LLMs). The ideal candidate will have mastery in data science platforms, significant software engineering experience, and expertise in LLMOps best practices. This role involves working on high-scale AI deployments, optimising LLM pipelines, and implementing responsible AI techniques.
 Requirements
Key Responsibilities:
ML & LLM Model Development: Build, deploy, and manage ML and LLM models on cloud-native platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Utilize LLM-specific frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex to develop sophisticated solutions, incorporating prompt engineering and dynamic response handling.
Apply LLMOps best practices for model development, training, fine-tuning, and monitoring, ensuring scalability and high availability.
Software Engineering & Production Optimization:
Drive software engineering efforts focused on scaling LLM and ML models in low-latency, high-throughput production environments.
Implement responsible AI practices, integrating LLM guardrails to maintain model reliability and ethical standards in production.
Streamline response generation with data/LLM response streaming and parallelized workloads to enhance model performance.
Cloud-Native Computing & Deployment:
Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for LLM deployment, leveraging DevOps principles and cloud-native technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
Establish and manage scalable cloud infrastructure, optimising resource utilization for parallelized ML and LLM workloads.
Advanced LLM Operations & Data Engineering:
Implement advanced LLM operations, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation, multi-agent deployments (CrewAI, AutoGen), and vector databases for efficient context retrieval.
Develop and maintain data engineering pipelines using technologies like Apache Spark and manage message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka) to support real-time model integrations.
Database Management & Optimization:
Optimize and manage databases like Postgres, MongoDB, SQL Server, Redis, and vector databases to support ML and LLM model workloads and enhance retrieval efficiency.
Ensure data integrity and model performance by fine-tuning database configurations for high-volume LLM deployments.
Required Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Experience:
8+ years of relevant experience, including mastery in data science platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP for building and deploying ML and LLM models.
Significant software engineering experience with a focus on ML/LLM model production, scalability in low-latency environments, and responsible AI implementation.
Proven expertise in LLMOps practices and frameworks
Technical Skills:
Programming & Frameworks: Proficiency in object-oriented programming languages and LLM-specific frameworks with expertise in prompt engineering.
Cloud & DevOps: Advanced understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native computing, and DevOps practices for ML and LLM deployments.
Data & Vector Management: In-depth knowledge of vector databases, LLM fine-tuning techniques, and the implementation of LLM guardrails.
Multi-Agent Systems: Experience with chatbot and multi-agent system deployments, including CrewAI, AutoGen, and LangGraph.
Data Engineering & Messaging: Experience with Data Engineering, message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and programming languages like Python, SQL, C++, R.
Database Optimization: Proficiency in databases such as Postgres, MongoDB, SQL Server, Redis, and their optimization for ML/LLM workloads.
Key Competencies:
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive attitude towards continuous learning.
Visionary mindset for shaping the future direction of LLMs and AI/ML at Scale.
Effective communication skills for translating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
A collaborative mindset and an inclination to mentor and uplift the technical capabilities of the team.

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
Opportunity to work in a dynamic and challenging environment on critical migration projects.
Professional growth opportunities in a supportive and forward-thinking organization.
